answer_1.quote: We introduce Falsesum, a data generation pipeline that produces NLI examples consisting of documents paired with gold summaries as positive examples and automatically generated inconsistent summaries as negative examples... We run the Falsesum data generation pipeline on the train split of the CNN/DailyMail corpus... We break the summaries down such that each Falsesum example consists of the document text and a single sentence summary.

answer_4.quote: We sample 200 generated negative examples and manually verify whether (i) the perturbed summary S- is indeed factually inconsistent; (ii) the type of consistency error follows the specified control code; (iii) the incorrect "fact" is inserted at the specified missing span... The authors perform this annotation to avoid high disagreement by crowd annotators in this task.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators check (i) factual inconsistency of the perturbed summary, (ii) whether the error type matches the control code (intrinsic or extrinsic), and (iii) whether the incorrect fact is inserted at the designated span.
